Every mount asks the configured endpoint what it serves — `GET /api/tags` for"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" membership, `POST /api/show` for each model's context window, input modalities, and the thinking la"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"dder plus default that model itself declares — and serves that answer. | The cache "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"of the last fetch | the same answer, read from disk before the network answers |
| The shipped snaps"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"hot | display names, and the fallback until some fetch has succeeded |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Two consequences worth knowing:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **A retired model leaves by itself.** A model the endpoint stops listing disappears, and one its l"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"isting still names but answers `404`/`410` for is dropped too — that answer is the endpoint saying i"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ts own listing is stale. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` through `0.2.1-rc.5`. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.1-rc.1` — the firs"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"t release whose `connection` row injects `webStartup` — so the `0.2.0` line is outside this release "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"(next bullet). The per-release verdicts live in `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`, and a future regres"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"sion is recorded in `dsh.compatibility.blocklist`.
- **The bundle patch follows the composition's `c"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"onnection` row.** `connection.rpc.handle()` mounts a channel through that row's own `webServer` — a "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"caller that injects `webServer` on its own row still throws `cannot get property "webServer" without"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" inject` — so this bundle restates the row's `inject` list with `webServer` added. That list also ca"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"rries the row's startup dependency, and that one is the composition's to change: the `0.2.0` line in"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"jects `webRuntime`, `0.2.1-rc.1` injects `webStartup`. A stale name there does not fail a request; i"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"t makes a required row wait forever and fails the whole boot, which is why `pnpm test` compares this"},{"id":"p24s11","text":" patch with the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` composition (`tests/composition.test.ts`) and `"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"engines.dsh` admits only the releases whose row injects `webStartup`. Rationale and rejected alterna"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"tives: ADR 0008.
- Runtime dependency: `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, declared at the generation the insta"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"lled harness speaks (`^1.1.0` for harness `0.2.1-rc.5`; the lockfile resolves `1.4.0`, a later minor"},{"id":"p24s15","text":" that range admits). pi-ai is **not** a host-shared package, so this copy and the harness's own only"},{"id":"p24s16","text":" agree while their generations do. The route normalizes the request context at its own boundary, whi"},{"id":"p24s17","text":"ch is the contract that changed between harness generations, so a `0.2.1` host drives it natively an"},{"id":"p24s18","text":"d the shim still absorbs a pre-0.87 context from an older one; `pnpm check` and the scheduled `pi-ai"},{"id":"p24s19","text":"-drift` workflow fail when the two declared ranges admit no common version, and the plugin logs one "},{"id":"p24s20","text":"mount-time warning when it can reach the installed harness's declaration and this build falls outsid"},{"id":"p24s21","text":"e it (best-effort: a host that hides its manifest reads as silence, and CI is the reliable signal). "},{"id":"p24s22","text":"Rationale: ADR 0004.
